name: Assisted Chest Dip
steps: Set the counterweight on an assisted dip machine, grip the wide handles firmly, and kneel carefully onto the assistance pad.
Lean your chest slightly forward, pack your shoulders down, and brace your core.
Bend your elbows slowly outward and back to lower your torso until you feel a controlled stretch across your chest.
Press firmly down through both handles to extend your arms back to the top without letting the pad bounce.
tips: Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears at the bottom of each repetition.
Step off one knee at a time while controlling the pad smoothly back to its rest.
